patterns: Language modules define ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY (optional), IMPORT_QUERY (optional), DEFUSE_QUERY (optional) as &str constants
Handler functions (extract_function_name, find_receiver_type, find_method_for_receiver, extract_inheritance) are optional and language-specific
LanguageInfo struct wired in get_language_info() match arm and get_ts_language() match arm
Extension map in lang.rs maps file extensions to language identifiers
DEFUSE_QUERY captures write sites (local_variable_declaration, assignment_expression) and read sites (identifier usage)
extract_inheritance walks AST to find base_clause (extends) and class_interface_clause (implements) children

related_issues.title: Add PHP language support via tree-sitter-php
related_issues.relevance: Direct parent issue; defines the task scope

constraints: All languages are unconditionally compiled in; no feature gates
PHP grammar distinguishes function_definition (top-level), method_declaration (in class/interface/trait), and anonymous_function/arrow_function
PHP has no enum type in grammar (PHP 8.1 enums are enum_declaration nodes)
Inheritance: base_clause for extends, class_interface_clause for implements (interfaces)
Traits are separate declaration type (trait_declaration); use_declaration inside class body references traits
test_coverage: Existing language modules have 5-8 tests each covering: element query validation (functions/classes/interfaces/enums), inheritance extraction, defuse query write/read sites, and edge cases. Integration tests in acceptance_tests.rs validate end-to-end analysis. PHP tests should follow this pattern.

library_findings.relevant_api: tree_sitter_php::LANGUAGE constant; node types: function_definition, method_declaration, class_declaration, interface_declaration, trait_declaration, enum_declaration, anonymous_function, arrow_function, function_call_expression
library_findings.notes: Grammar distinguishes top-level functions (function_definition) from methods (method_declaration). Inheritance via base_clause (extends) and class_interface_clause (implements). Enums supported via enum_declaration with enum_case children. Traits via trait_declaration and use_declaration.

library_findings.relevant_api: Query API for tree-sitter queries; Node field access via child_by_field_name(); named_child() for iteration
library_findings.notes: Query syntax uses @capture labels and field accessors (e.g., name:, body:, superclass:). All language handlers use Query::new() to compile and QueryCursor::matches() to execute.

approaches.name: Approach 1: Full-featured PHP handler with all optional handlers
approaches.description: Create crates/aptu-coder-core/src/languages/php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY covering function_definition, method_declaration, class_declaration, interface_declaration, trait_declaration, enum_declaration; CALL_QUERY for function_call_expression; REFERENCE_QUERY for qualified_name/name nodes; IMPORT_QUERY for use_declaration; DEFUSE_QUERY for local variable and assignment tracking; implement extract_function_name, find_receiver_type, find_method_for_receiver, extract_inheritance handlers. Register in mod.rs get_language_info() and get_ts_language() match arms. Add (.php) extension to lang.rs EXTENSION_MAP. Add tree-sitter-php to Cargo.toml workspace dependencies. Write 9+ unit tests covering all query types and handlers.
pros: Maximizes feature parity with Java/Kotlin/C# handlers
Enables full semantic analysis: method receiver tracking, inheritance chains, def-use sites
Supports all PHP declaration types including traits and enums
Comprehensive test coverage reduces regression risk
cons: Largest implementation effort (~400-500 LOC for handler + tests)
Requires careful handling of PHP's optional method bodies (abstract methods)
DEFUSE_QUERY complexity due to PHP's dynamic typing and variable variables

approaches.name: Approach 2: Minimal PHP handler (CSS-like) with only ELEMENT_QUERY and CALL_QUERY
approaches.description: Create crates/aptu-coder-core/src/languages/php.rs with only ELEMENT_QUERY (functions, classes, interfaces, traits, enums) and CALL_QUERY (function calls). Set all optional handlers to None. Register in mod.rs and lang.rs. Add tree-sitter-php to Cargo.toml. Write 3-4 basic tests for element and call extraction. Faster to ship but limits semantic analysis capabilities.
pros: Sufficient for basic code structure extraction
Follows CSS precedent for minimal language support
cons: No receiver type tracking (methods not linked to classes)
Limited value for semantic analysis tasks

approaches.name: Approach 3: Intermediate PHP handler with ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY, and extract_inheritance only
approaches.description: Create php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY, and implement extract_inheritance handler. Omit extract_function_name, find_receiver_type, find_method_for_receiver. Register in mod.rs and lang.rs. Add tree-sitter-php to Cargo.toml. Write 6-7 tests. Balances feature coverage with implementation effort.
pros: Enables inheritance tracking and def-use analysis
Covers most common semantic analysis needs
Good balance of features vs. complexity
cons: extract_inheritance required to handle base_clause and class_interface_clause field navigation

recommendation: Approach 1 (full-featured handler). PHP is a widely-used language with rich OOP features (classes, interfaces, traits, enums). The project's design philosophy prioritizes semantic completeness for supported languages. Approach 1 enables receiver type tracking (critical for method resolution), inheritance chains (required for understanding class hierarchies), and def-use analysis (needed for refactoring tasks). The implementation effort is justified by the language's prevalence and the completeness it brings to the analysis toolkit. The DEFUSE_QUERY is required because PHP's dynamic typing and variable variables make static analysis valuable for def-use tracking (e.g., identifying where $this->property is assigned vs. read). Reference implementations (Java, Python, Kotlin) all include DEFUSE_QUERY, establishing it as a standard expectation for new languages.

    pub language: Language,
    pub element_query: &'static str,
    pub call_query: &'static str,
    pub reference_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub import_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_query: Option<&'static str>,

    pub extract_function_name: Option<ExtractFunctionNameHandler>,
    pub find_method_for_receiver: Option<FindMethodForReceiverHandler>,
    pub find_receiver_type: Option<FindReceiverTypeHandler>,
    pub extract_inheritance: Option<ExtractInheritanceHandler>,
}

  (interface_declaration name: (name) @interface_name) @class

inheritance_walk_citation: For class_declaration: walk child nodes to find base_clause (field name 'base_clause' via child_by_field_name). base_clause contains named children of type name, qualified_name, or relative_name representing the superclass. For class_declaration: walk child nodes to find class_interface_clause (field name 'class_interface_clause' via child_by_field_name). class_interface_clause contains multiple named children of type name, qualified_name, or relative_name representing each implemented interface. For interface_declaration: walk child nodes to find base_clause for parent interfaces. Source: tree-sitter-php node-types.json class_declaration, interface_declaration, base_clause, class_interface_clause definitions.
